title: 金价逼近4000美元关口 央行购金创纪录
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Historically, there's three goals and gold achieves that, either they want stability, they want liquidity, they want returns. But what we've seen over the past four years is that
segments.zh: 历史上，黄金能满足三个目标：稳定性、流动性、回报。但过去四年我们看到

segments.en: there are additional reasons to want to buy gold. In addition to diversification, its concerns around geopolitical risks, it's wanting to have a store of value, it's wanting to have that hedge,
segments.zh: 购买黄金的理由增加了。除了分散风险，还有地缘政治担忧、保值需求、对冲需求，

segments.en: and it's not just central banks, we're seeing that play out through the investor side as well.
segments.zh: 不仅是央行，市场参与者也在这么做。

segments.en: But for central banks in particular, they've been the marginal buyer.
segments.zh: 尤其是央行，一直是边际买家。

segments.en: Is it a return to the 1930s and 1920s, the 1910s?
It's not so much a return to the, to wanting to have that monetary stability, it's more so wanting to strengthen balance sheets and have optionality,
segments.zh: 与其说是回归货币稳定，不如说是为了强化资产负债表和保持灵活性，

segments.en: but also wanting to diversify at the same time. So there's a central bank gold survey that was released last week, and this is, I'd say, the best survey for us to be looking at, because it signals from
segments.zh: 同时也要分散风险。上周发布的央行黄金调查是最好的参考，它显示了

segments.en: 76 different central banks what their intentions are. And we had a record 45 percent saying that they intended to increase their own gold reserves over the next 12 months.
segments.zh: 76家央行的意图。创纪录的45%表示未来12个月计划增持黄金。

segments.en: That's the highest we've had. And when we had such strong figures in the past, it's translated into record value terms in additions.
segments.zh: 这是最高比例。过去如此强劲的数据都转化为创纪录的增持量。

segments.en: Since the end of January of this year, gold's down about 25 percent, and we're now we're below $4,000 per ounce. What's going on there? It's a historic day in that we've seen the lowest settlement
segments.zh: 自今年1月底以来，金价下跌约25%，现已跌破每盎司4000美元。发生了什么？这是历史性的一天，我们看到了最低结算价。

segments.en: since November 2025. We've seen a huge pivot from January to now to what the gold market's
segments.zh: 自2025年11月以来，从1月至今，黄金市场出现了巨大转变。
